verdict.rationale: Keyless or file-number entry is a fair question for a state business-filing service, so the axis applies. The pack documents no such path: the Ohio Business Gateway pages describe logging in with OHID as the sign-in layer for business filings. The Secretary of State's own sites (ohiosos.gov, bsportal.ohiosos.gov) returned 403 at robots.txt, so no published SOS page showing an account-free or file-number entry was available.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
